plan.title: RFQ auto title waits for location

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the requested product with quantity 10 while leaving its delivery location unset.
Confirm the intended product was added.
Confirm the product automatically receives the Default Variant.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify the title remains empty while delivery location is unset.
Pick Plant Name as the delivery location to trigger auto-title generation.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [RFQ] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify the generated title includes the RFQ prefix, product, and selected location.
